label: Battista de Vilanis
summary: Servant of Leonardo in France, beneficiary of the will of 1519.

value.text: Bequests in the will of 23 April 1519

claims.statement: The will leaves him half of the garden (vineyard) outside the walls of Milan, the water rights of the San Cristoforo canal granted by Louis XII, and furnishings at Cloux.

sources.cite: Richter, The Notebooks of Leonardo da Vinci, section 1566 (text of the will, English), online mirror. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

Amoretti, Memorie storiche su la vita, gli studj e le opere di Lionardo da Vinci (1804), page image on Wikisource (Italian text of the will). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

value.text: His half of the vineyard passed to San Gerolamo by 1534

claims.statement: His lot is reported to have been transferred to the monastery of San Gerolamo by 1534.

sources.cite: Wikipedia, Leonardo da Vinci's Vineyard. Background only, not a ground. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

check_in: Archivio di Stato di Milano, as published in the vineyard studies

value.text: French royal accounts list him in Leonardo's household

claims.statement: Royal accounts of 1517 to 1518 are said to record a payment to Battista as servant. Not confirmed in this round.
